---
title: "R code to generate Change from baseline across timepoints plot"
output: html_document
params:
    continuous_data: NA
    no_doseE: NA
    func_E: NA
    final_tE: NA
    continuous_date: NA
    title: NA
    titlesize: NA
    axissize: 30
    x_lab: "Timepoint"
    y_lab: "Score in PRO domain"
    arrow_lab: "Better \n tolerability"
    range: c(0,100)
---

```{r}
print(params[-1])

## To install the required packages, uncomment the following lines and run the code
# install.packages(c("ggplot2", "DT", "magrittr", "dplyr", "ggsurvfit", "ggh4x", "tidyr", "gt", "gridExtra", "survminer"))

library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(survminer)

# Define the parameters
continuous_data <- params$continuous_data
no_doseE <- params$no_doseE
func_E <- params$func_E
final_tE <- params$final_tE
continuous_date <- params$continuous_date

# Function to handle date data
date_to_timepoint_continuous <- function(data) {
    data %>%
        group_by(id, functioning) %>%
        arrange(timepoint) %>%
        mutate(date = timepoint, timepoint = row_number() - 1) %>%
        ungroup()
}

# Logic handling date format for the data
if (continuous_date == TRUE) {
    # continuous_data$timepoint <- as.Date(continuous_data$timepoint)
    continuous_data <- date_to_timepoint_continuous(continuous_data)
}

# Filter to specific PRO domain, dose, and final timepoint
continuous_data <- continuous_data %>%
    filter(functioning == func_E) %>%
    dplyr::select(-functioning)
continuous_data <- continuous_data %>%
    filter(dose %in% no_doseE) %>%
    filter(timepoint <= final_tE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(score))

# Set up the improvement and worsening bounds
bounds <- params$range
maxval <- max(continuous_data$score, na.rm = TRUE)
minval <- min(continuous_data$score, na.rm = TRUE)
lower <- min(c(minval, bounds[1]))
upper <- max(c(maxval, bounds[2]))


# Generate the plot
ggplot(continuous_data, aes(x = as.factor(timepoint), y = score, fill = as.factor(dose))) +
    labs(fill = "Dose") +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    xlab(params$x_lab) +
    ylab(params$y_lab) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0.2, xend = 0.2, y = lower, yend = upper),
        colour = "darkgrey", size = 0.8, arrow = arrow(
            type = "closed",
            length = unit(0.1, "inches")
        )
    ) +
    ylim(c(lower, upper)) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(2, 0))) +
    geom_text(aes(x = -0.45, y = upper * 0.9, label = params$arrow_lab)) +
    ggtitle(params$title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = params$titlesize, face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(size = params$axissize))
```
